issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify Animal.messageOnFeed() as returning a String, but the solution introduces a FeedResponse return type (Animal.messageOnFeed(): FeedResponse) and a FeedResponse class. This changes the core contract students must implement and is not mentioned in the problem or template, causing confusion about the expected return type and usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the return type across artifacts. Either revert the solution to have Animal.messageOnFeed() return String (remove or stop using FeedResponse) and have all Animal subclasses return String as described in the problem, or update the problem statement and template to explicitly introduce and document FeedResponse as the required return type and adapt all instructions and examples accordingly.

issues.description: Within the solution repository there is an inconsistency: Animal.messageOnFeed() is declared to return FeedResponse, but Goat.messageOnFeed() is implemented to return String. This makes the solution codebase internally inconsistent and would not compile.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Goat implementation consistent with the Animal declaration. If Animal.messageOnFeed() remains FeedResponse, update Goat.messageOnFeed() to return a FeedResponse instance (e.g. new FeedResponse("Maah!", true)). If the contract is changed to return String, update Animal and all implementations accordingly and remove FeedResponse.
